title: Two lights over the USS Holland off Spain
place_text: USS Holland, off the coast of Spain

tellings.quote: just as I was looking back, I saw these two lights coming toward us.

plain: In 1970, aboard the Navy ship USS Holland off the coast of Spain, a man named Charlie Foltz says he looked back and saw two lights coming toward the ship. Foltz tells this on the show as someone who was there and saw it. It is told as an unexplained sighting by a Navy sailor at sea.
